solar.action: Re-strip the wire so the screw clamps copper, not the insulation.

no-hot-tank.action: Replace the valve. Never plug it.

furnace.action: A tech can jump the blue wires at the furnace to see if the board is getting a call. Do not leave them jumped.

brakes.look: One wheel locks or the drum is out of round
brakes.action: Out-of-round drums show up in a service bulletin. Do not tow with a brake that will not release.

tires.look: Bearing noise or a hot hub
tires.action: On Nev-R-Lube axles, check end play and that the hub rotates freely. A hot hub is a stop, not a later job.

st-hot.look: Cold water crossing into the hot side
st-hot.action: A shower-head pause button or an open bypass will do this. Close the bypass and do not shower on the trickle button.

st-hot.look: It fires, then goes cold, and the LP supply is the suspect
st-hot.action: Have the regulator and LP pressure tested. A weak regulator on a late Globetrotter has been the cause.

fes.look: Rivets at the front locker, or a gap in the front seam
fes.action: Inspect for front-end separation. Replace the rivets. Do not just caulk the seam.
